Fictional support app used by OpenMerit's tests: a ticket classifier and a reply drafter on `gpt-4.1-mini`, and an escalation router on `gpt-5.4`. `npm run eval:classify` measures the classifier: one pass/fail per ticket in `data/tickets.jsonl`, limited to `OPENMERIT_ITEMS` when set. With `CLASSIFY_LANGFUSE_DATASET` set, it also records the run as a Langfuse experiment named `OPENMERIT_EXPERIMENT`, with a boolean `correct` score per ticket, using the app's own `LANGFUSE_*` keys.
